question: What is the department name of the students with lowest gpa belongs to?
failed_sql: SELECT dept_name FROM STUDENT ORDER BY STU_GPA ASC LIMIT 1
target_sql: SELECT DEPARTMENT.DEPT_NAME FROM STUDENT JOIN DEPARTMENT ON STUDENT.DEPT_CODE = DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY STUDENT.STU_GPA ASC LIMIT 1

question: list in alphabetic order all course names and their instructors' names in year 2008.
failed_sql: SELECT t1.title , instructor.name FROM course AS t1 JOIN instructor AS t2 ON t1.dept_name  =  t2.dept_name WHERE t1.year  =  2008 ORDER BY t1.title , t2.name
target_sql:
SELECT c.title, i.name
FROM course AS c
JOIN section AS s ON c.course_id = s.course_id
JOIN teaches AS t ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.sec_id = t.sec_id AND s.semester = t.semester AND s.year = t.year
JOIN instructor AS i ON t.ID = i.ID
WHERE s.year = 2008
ORDER BY c.title, i.name

target_sql: SELECT Location_Name, Location_Description FROM Ref_Locations WHERE Location_Code = 'x'

question: How many routes go from the United States to Canada?
failed_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM routes WHERE dst_ap  =  'Canada' AND country  =  'United States'
target_sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM routes r
JOIN airports src ON r.src_apid = src.apid
JOIN airports dst ON r.dst_apid = dst.apid
WHERE src.country = 'United States' AND dst.country = 'Canada'

question: What is detail of the student who most recently registered course?

question: What is the title, credit value, and department name for courses with more than one prerequisite?
failed_sql: SELECT title ,  credits ,  dept_name FROM course WHERE credits  >  0 AND prereq_id  =  0
target_sql: SELECT c.title, c.credits, c.dept_name FROM course c JOIN prereq p ON c.course_id = p.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Show different tourist attractions' names, ids, and the corresponding number of visits.

question: Return the distinct name of customers whose order status is Pending, in the order of customer id.

question: Find the names and average salaries of all departments whose average salary is greater than 42000.

target_sql: SELECT t1.dept_name , AVG(t2.salary) FROM department AS t1 JOIN instructor AS t2 ON t1.dept_name = t2.dept_name GROUP BY t1.dept_name HAVING AVG(t2.salary) > 42000
